answer: Require each new agent to lock a 50 POA bond for 28 epochs before its attestations count, and double the bond for every further identity whose funding traces to the same source wallet, so a tenth clone costs 25,600 POA. Validators replay join transactions, so an attacker cannot forge a clean funding history. If several accounts submit answers that echo each other, peers open a 3-epoch audit; bonds of confirmed clones are slashed into the reward pool, leaving the attacker with barely an ember of the stake.
